slug: ydb-core
description: Read this skill before answering YDB introductions and comparisons with other databases, setup, SDK/integration selection, CLI namespace operations or general client-policy questions, including advice-only requests. Covers local Docker setup (image, ports, and database endpoint); local/hosted connection strings, TLS, authentication, service-account credentials and environment variables; CLI discovery and safe `ydb scheme` operations; client-side balancing, session lifecycle under rolling restart, and end-to-end deadline, cancellation and retry budgets. Covers Go driver/session lifecycle reviews. For Go, C++ and Java/JDBC/ORM code/configuration reviews, also read ydb-table and its matching rules; Python audit coverage there is FloatVector parameters only. Use ydb-table for SQL/query execution and query-oriented schema design. Use specialist skills for topics or coordination, and ydb-docs for standalone documentation lookup. Questions unrelated to YDB are outside scope.

slug: ydb-docs
description: Find and verify official documentation for the YDB database (СУБД YDB) on ydb.tech. Load only when the requested documentation concerns YDB itself or a YDB-specific part of a mixed question. Covers YDB source links, citations, fact checking, and lookup plans without network access. Can support another YDB skill when documentation is needed. Supports Russian or English and requested YDB product versions.

slug: ydb-table
description: Open and read this SKILL.md file before answering requests to write, explain, execute or review SQL/YQL queries or query-oriented schemas for the YDB database, or to audit YDB code/configuration in Go, C++ or Java/JDBC/ORM (including driver initialization and balancing), or Python FloatVector parameter handling. This includes short syntax questions, parameters, transactions, EXPLAIN and SQL migration to YDB. Otherwise do not activate or open this skill, even to check applicability. YQL on YT/YTsaurus is outside scope. General YDB introductions/comparisons, local setup, connection/authentication, SDK selection and shared client policy belong to ydb-core; SDK code/configuration reviews may also use core for shared driver/session policy. Standalone official-documentation lookup belongs to ydb-docs. SQL/YQL review applies in any host language. For audits, read the matching language rules; Python covers FloatVector only.
